description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different categories of reasoning types found within the R2I-Bench dataset for benchmarking reasoning-driven text-to-image generation. The chart contains six slices, each representing a distinct reasoning category. These categories are, in clockwise order starting from the top: Disjunctive & Conjunctive (light purple, 50.49%), Approximate Quantities (yellow, 45.03%), Comparative Relationships (light blue, 36.26%), Universal Quantifiers (light orange, 29.07%), Negation (coral, 27.91%), and Existential Quantifiers (light green, 15.12%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend provides the category names alongside corresponding colors. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion, visually descending in a clockwise direction. Additionally, a category labeled “Limiter” with a proportion of 27.91% and “Absolute Absence” with a proportion of 18.71% are also shown.
